summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared private network 10.100.50.0/24: it authoritatively answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.50.11) via a VyOS authoritative-domain zone, and forwards all other queries upstream to 10.100.50.1. Configured node2 and node3 (RHEL10) via NetworkManager to use node1 (10.100.50.10) as their sole DNS resolver. Verified resolution end-to-end from both client nodes, then restarted all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of DNS service/config after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (VyOS 2026.04 rolling, 10.100.50.10), node2 (RHEL10, 10.100.50.11), node3 (RHEL10, 10.100.50.12) network/OS state
Located VyOS pdns-recursor conf_mode script/templates to find the 'authoritative-domain <zone> records a @ address <ip>' syntax for apex A records

Configured node1: service dns forwarding listen-address 10.100.50.10, allow-from 10.100.50.0/24, name-server 10.100.50.1 (upstream forwarder), authoritative-domain inventory.internal records a @ address 10.100.50.11 ttl 300; committed and saved
Verified node1 answers inventory.internal -> 10.100.50.11 and forwards example.com upstream via dig
Configured node2 and node3 via nmcli (ipv4.dns 10.100.50.10, ipv4.ignore-auto-dns yes) on their private-network connection, applied live
Verified node2 and node3 resolve inventory.internal to 10.100.50.11 and example.com upstream via getent hosts
Captured baseline boot_id on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via sudo reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified pdns-recursor active and correct DNS answers post-reboot
Restarted node2 via sudo systemctl reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified resolv.conf and DNS resolution correct post-reboot
Restarted node3 via sudo systemctl reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, verified resolv.conf and DNS resolution correct post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as authoritative resolver for inventory.internal -> node2 address, forwarding else upstream
evidence.summary: Located VyOS authoritative-domain record syntax, applied config (listen/allow-from/name-server/authoritative zone), and confirmed via dig that inventory.internal resolves to 10.100.50.11 while example.com forwards upstream

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured to resolve through node1
evidence.summary: nmcli set ipv4.dns to 10.100.50.10 on both nodes; getent hosts confirms inventory.internal -> 10.100.50.11 and example.com resolved via node1
